title: Azure OpenAI Service
description: Explore Azure OpenAI Service, GPT model deployment, responsible AI features, and content filters that help you safely integrate large language models.

data.text: Azure OpenAI Service gives you access to powerful large language models like GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-Turbo inside your Azure environment. Unlike the public OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI runs inside your Azure subscription, which means Microsoft handles compliance, data residency, and private network access. You deploy a model to a specific region, configure rate limits, and call it just like any other Azure service.

data.title: Deployment Options
items: Provisioned throughput: reserve a fixed amount of requests per minute for predictable workloads.
Provisioned managed: pay-as-you-go throughput with automatic scaling for variable demand.
Standard single model: deploy one model per deployment and switch versions without changing client code.

data.title: Content Safety Is Built In
data.text: Azure OpenAI includes a content filtering system that blocks harmful prompts and responses. You can adjust the severity level, but the filter is always on. Test your application with diverse inputs to understand how the filter behaves.
Example: Call Azure OpenAI from C#

data.title: Send a Chat Completion Request in C#
data.content: Use the Azure.AI.OpenAI NuGet package to send a chat message to a deployed GPT model.

data.text: Microsoft provides tools and documentation for responsible AI, including transparency notes that explain model behavior, a responsible use dashboard, and integration with Azure Content Safety. These resources help you build applications that treat users fairly and reduce harmful outputs.

data.title: Azure OpenAI vs. Public OpenAI API

cards.title: Azure OpenAI
cards.description: Runs inside your Azure subscription with private networking, enterprise compliance, and regional data residency.
pros: Data stays in your Azure tenant.
Integrated content safety and responsible AI controls.
cons: Requires an Azure subscription and approved access form.
Deployment and quota setup takes more time.

cards.title: Public OpenAI API
cards.description: Hosted by OpenAI directly. Quick to start and widely documented for consumer and prototype applications.
pros: Fastest way to try GPT models.

data.text: Azure OpenAI integrates with Azure Monitor so you can track request volume, latency, token usage, and content filter hits. Use these metrics to detect abuse, manage costs, and tune system prompts based on real usage patterns.

data.title: Deploy a GPT Model and Send a Request
data.description: Provision an Azure OpenAI resource, deploy a GPT-3.5-Turbo model, and send a test chat request using C#.
steps: Create an Azure OpenAI resource in the Azure portal.
Deploy a GPT-3.5-Turbo model to your resource.
Install the Azure.AI.OpenAI NuGet package in a console app.
Send a chat completion request and print the response.
data.expectedOutcome: You can authenticate to Azure OpenAI from C#, call the chat completions API, and read the generated text response.
